thread:
leo: Onboarding new account `gnarwhal` into ap-northeast-5. We need quota/entitlement bumps before traffic cutover next week. TL;DR asks below, please open support cases and ping when created.

Required: 
- p5 family GPUs: current 8 -> request 32 (spread across 3 AZs)
- g5 family GPUs: current 16 -> request 64
- ENI limit per AZ + private IPv4 pool bump to a /20 for this account
- Allow EC2 instance profile for `redwood-operator` to attach instances in ap-northeast-5 (tenancy/attachment permission)

We want fast turnaround (ideally <72h). Cost note: this will be short-term ramp; we can dial down after onboarding.

jordan: I can open the cases. Quick clarifying Qs: do you want p5 across 3 AZs evenly (e.g., 12/10/10) or just quota total? Also need target ENI per AZ value — current is 60, want 250?

leo: total quota is the priority, but call it 32 with AZ distribution left to AWS. For ENI, bump per-AZ from 60 -> 250 and request /20 private IPv4 pool (so we don't hit CIDR exhaustion during rollout).

maria: FYI if AWS asks for use-case details: say "production inference for customer workloads requiring p5/g5 GPU families in ap-northeast-5; short ramp for tenant onboarding; traffic will be ~200 concurrent inference sessions at peak." Keep it high level, mention we have infra team and will monitor.

jordan: Cool. Drafting support case texts now. I'll open 4 cases (p5 quota, g5 quota, ENI+IPv4 pool, and IAM/tenancy permission). Will paste case IDs here once created.

jordan: Case created: 1234567891 — Request to increase P5 accelerator quota to 32 in ap-northeast-5 (attached justification + AZ spread note).

jordan: Case created: 1234567892 — Request to increase G5 accelerator quota to 64 in ap-northeast-5.

jordan: Case created: 1234567893 — Request to increase ENI limit per AZ to 250 and allocate /20 private IPv4 pool to account `gnarwhal`. Provided subnet plan and expected IP consumption.

jordan: Case created: 1234567894 — Request to allow `redwood-operator` instance profile to attach EC2 instances and set tenancy exceptions for ap-northeast-5. Included role ARN and operator runbook link.

aws-entitlements: Support ticket 1234567891 updated: "Reviewed initial request. We may need region-level account verification and additional billing/contact info. Please provide estimated monthly spend and point-of-contact."

leo: Put finance contact as marla@redwood.com and estimated peak monthly spend ~12k USD for the onboarding window. I can add runbook link.

jordan: Provided finance contact and runbook links in all cases. Marked priority as "production onboarding" and requested 72h SLA.

maria: Suggestion: while entitlements are pending, lock in instance reservations if possible (or at least soft-plan checkpoints). If AWS needs capacity proof, we can provide rollout schedule and traffic curves.

leo: Good idea. I'll coordinate with capacity-planning to prepare a short packet we can attach if AWS asks.

sre-bot: Reminder: create a post in #incidents if any quota denial blocks critical rollout. Also add a temporary override group for the tenant in our capacity tracker (gnarwhal-onboard).

leo: Awesome, thanks all. Please update here when any case moves to "approved" or AWS asks for more info.

jordan: Will do. ping me if you want me to escalate to account team after 48h.
